targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(distinct user_id) as developers FROM ${athena_database}.logs WHERE year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) AND year * 10000 + month * 100 + day BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) * 10000 + month($__timeFrom()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) * 10000 + month($__timeTo()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeTo()) AND coalesce(service_name, '') NOT LIKE 'codex%'

SELECT coalesce(sum(cast(input_tokens as bigint)),0) + coalesce(sum(cast(output_tokens as bigint)),0) as tokens FROM ${athena_database}.logs WHERE year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) AND year * 10000 + month * 100 + day BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) * 10000 + month($__timeFrom()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) * 10000 + month($__timeTo()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeTo()) AND event_name = 'api_request'
